neighbours.label: ' of' (and ' inside') after a part-of-object spatial noun in hands-on instructions: 'inside of', 'edge of', 'side of' a physical object
fire: Apply a thin line of paint to the inside of the bead holes.
Run glue along the inside edge of the front half.
Cut a groove into one side of each wooden piece.
Sand the outer rim of the bowl until it is smooth.
Press the lead back inside the pencil before you scratch.
Drill a hole near the bottom of the plastic bucket.
Wipe the inner surface of the jar with a clean cloth.
Mark the center of the board with a pencil line.
quiet: Apply a thin line of paint, then let the beads dry fully.
Run the glue gun slowly so the front half stays clean.
Cut a groove carefully so each wooden piece fits.
Sand the bowl until it is smooth and ready to oil.
Press the pencil gently before you scratch the page.
Drill a hole slowly so the plastic bucket does not crack.
Wipe the jar with a clean cloth and set it aside.
Mark the board with a pencil line and a ruler.

notes: Top 32: ' of' x10 after inside/edge/side; also ' contain', ' although'.
